bank_name: National Credit and Commerce Bank PLC
period_note: Half-Yearly unaudited report used as the project's Q2 data point. Cumulative-from-Jan-1 convention established from the filing's own column header '01 January to 30 June 2022'. Standalone/Solo basis. Source PDF (half_yearly_report_2022.pdf) is a native digital PDF with a clean pdftotext -layout extraction; figures cross-verified: balance sheet ties to the taka (Total Liabilities 262,219,136,238 + Total Shareholders' Equity 23,493,765,518 = Total Assets 285,712,901,755); Profit after provision 2,737,359,702 - Contribution to NCC Bank's CSR Fund 25,129,119 = Profit before tax 2,712,230,584 - Provision for tax 1,161,820,441 = Profit after tax (full) 1,550,410,142; less 'Interest on perpetual bonds' (BDT 224.4mn) = 'Net profit attributable to ordinary shareholders' BDT 1,325,962,323, the basis for the reported EPS of 1.30. profit_after_tax_cumulative below is the FULL PAT, per project convention. Note: the comparative 'H1 2021' EPS shown here (1.23) differs from the 1.32 originally reported in the 2021_Q2.json record even though PAT is identical (BDT 1,250.48mn in both) -- paid-up capital rose from BDT 9,459.26mn (30 Jun 2021) to BDT 10,168.71mn (Sep 2021) and further to BDT 10,575.46mn (Sep 2022) via bonus share issues, and this filing's comparative EPS/NAV appear recomputed on the later, larger share count for comparability -- a routine BAS 33 share-count restatement, not a profit restatement. Cross-check: comparative '31 December 2021' Total Shareholders' Equity (BDT 22,196.36mn) matches the existing bank_financials/NCCBANK/quarterly/2021_Q4.json exactly; comparative Total Assets (BDT 277,894.17mn) is about 1.0% above that file's BDT 275,037mn, the same asset/liability-side-only gap noted in the 2022_Q1 file.
